annotations.title: Switch campaign check-ins on or off

description:
[writes flayr data · `write` scope] Switch scheduled check-ins on or off for one campaign (owner or admin only). Switching on makes each future check-in charge Embers, so it needs confirmEmbers equal to checkpointEmbers from the read tool; ask the owner first. A check-in under the minimum spend is skipped free. Changes no ad, budget or campaign.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/ads/campaigns/{id}/checkpoints.)

brandId.description: A brand id (GET /api/v2/brands) or "personal"; default: the key owner's active brand.

confirmEmbers.description: checkpointEmbers from the GET, required to switch on.

name: ads_checkpoints_set
